scope: Separate worker on Opus 5.5 with its own brief. Never reads bed templates, train-pools prompts or outputs, or bed-group code: it gets the port contracts and examples of meaning only. Writes to .foundry/kev-data/heldout/ (git-ignored) and commits only sha256 manifests.
